goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, and cash rose steadily. It opened the SHOP and bought Silver Ore, Dropper 3 and Speed 1, and the REBIRTH button produced a rebirth ("REBIRTH x1.5!", rebirths=1). The Buy buttons on the Cash x1.5 (mult1) and Gold Ore cards never fired, and the trace has no step where the TOP TYCOONS board was looked at.

bugs.title: Shop Buy buttons for Gold Ore and Cash x1.5 (mult1) do nothing when pressed
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 2, 13 and 18: pressing Card_mult1.State ('Buy' at 739,640) returned 'button did NOT fire'. Steps 15 and 17: pressing Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744) did not fire with cash 813 to 1.3K against a $500 price. Buy buttons on other cards (Dropper 2/3, Silver Ore) fired. The cards sit lower in the list and may be clipped or unclickable. There is no feedback explaining the failure and the probe shows no error.

bugs.title: REBIRTH can fire while the button shows less than 100% progress, and denial gives little feedback
bugs.evidence: Step 4 pressed 'REBIRTH $5000 (99%)'. At step 5 the HUD showed 'REBIRTH x1.5!' and the next cost was $10.0K (0%). The playtester believed cash was short of the cost at the time. The later presses (steps 11 and 16) were denied, with rebirth_denied=5, and only a small 'Need $X more to rebirth' text appeared.

bugs.title: TotalEarned attribute value is implausibly huge
bugs.evidence: The playtester saw TotalEarned go from 2000000005789 to 2000000005805 (about 2 trillion) after only a few minutes of play, which suggests a bad starting value or a debug seed. This could distort the TOP TYCOONS board.

bugs.title: Shop cards show no price or affordability reason on the Buy button
bugs.evidence: The playtester could not tell why the mult1 and Gold Ore Buy presses did nothing (steps 1, 2, 15, 17). The card state is only 'Buy' or 'Owned', with no cost or locked message.
